name: madi
description: Local-first Windows authoring tool with Publication IR-based EPUB and HWPX export

scripts.build: npm run prepare:epubcheck && npm run build:core && npm run build:epub && npm run build:hwpx && npm run build:atomic-output && npm run build --workspace @madi/desktop
scripts.dev: npm run prepare:epubcheck && npm run build:core && npm run build:epub && npm run build:hwpx && npm run build:atomic-output && npm run dev --workspace @madi/desktop
scripts.start: npm run prepare:epubcheck && npm run start --workspace @madi/desktop
scripts.test: npm run build:core && npm run build:epub && npm run build:hwpx && npm run build:atomic-output && npm run typecheck && npm run test:typie && npm run test:publication && npm run test:epub && npm run test:hwpx && npm run test:atomic-output && npm run test:epubcheck && npm run test:core && npm run test:desktop && npm run test:integration && npm run test:electron
scripts.test:integration: npm run test:phase1a && npm run test:phase1b && npm run test:phase1c && npm run test:phase1e && node scripts/test-madi-roundtrip.mjs && node scripts/test-madi-endurance.mjs && node scripts/test-scene-break.mjs && node scripts/test-recovery-cli.mjs
scripts.pretest:electron: npm run prepare:epubcheck && npm run fixture:phase1d-scale && npm run fixture:phase1e-scale && npm run fixture:phase1f-reader && npm run build:epub && npm run build:hwpx && npm run build:atomic-output && npm run build --workspace @madi/desktop
scripts.test:electron: node scripts/electron-smoke.mjs && node scripts/electron-scale-smoke.mjs && node scripts/electron-phase1e-dev-smoke.mjs && node scripts/electron-phase1f-dev-smoke.mjs && node scripts/electron-phase1g-dev-smoke.mjs && node scripts/electron-phase1h-dev-smoke.mjs
scripts.package:unpacked: npm run build:core:release && npm run build:epub:release && npm run build:hwpx:release && npm run build:atomic-output:release && npm run build --workspace @madi/desktop && node scripts/package-unpacked.mjs
scripts.pretest:package: npm run fixture:phase1d-scale && npm run fixture:phase1e-scale && npm run fixture:phase1f-reader && npm run package:unpacked
scripts.test:package: node scripts/electron-packaged-smoke.mjs && node scripts/electron-packaged-scale-smoke.mjs && node scripts/electron-phase1e-packaged-smoke.mjs && node scripts/electron-phase1f-packaged-smoke.mjs && node scripts/electron-phase1g-packaged-smoke.mjs && node scripts/electron-phase1h-packaged-smoke.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run check:toolchain && npm run check:repository && npm run format:check && npm run test:runtime-tcp-families && npm run prepare:epubcheck && npm run build:atomic-output && npm run typecheck && npm run test:desktop && npm run test:publication && npm run test:epub && npm run test:hwpx && npm run test:atomic-output && npm run test:epubcheck && npm run test:core && npm run build:core && npm run build:epub && npm run build:hwpx && npm run test:typie && npm run test:integration && npm run build && npm run test:bundle && npm run test:electron && npm run test:package
